description: If fewer than b many families of natural-number functions are individually eventually bounded, their union is eventually bounded.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.bounded_iUnion {ι : Type} (B : ι → Set (ℕ → ℕ))
  (hι : Cardinal.mk ι < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.boundingNumber)
  (hB : ∀ (i : ι), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsBounded (B i)) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsBounded (⋃ i, B i)
